evidence: Wegg, Gerhard and Portail (2015) infer a 5.0 ± 0.2 kpc half-length for their two-component bar and an angle of 28–33 degrees to the Sun–center line. The diagram uses an approximately 10 kpc full length and 30-degree orientation. Random star glyphs, the bar width and the Sun's radial placement are illustrative, explicitly not measured catalog positions. No spiral-arm geometry is asserted.
